question: Which epidemiological week will be the onset week for the flu in HHS Region 5 in 2026-27?

calls.reasoning: CDC week 45 report: Region 5 ILI rising but below baseline (regions 3,5,7 below). Delphi API returned Region 5 wILI 1.23/1.46/1.64/1.83 for weeks 42-45, but later identical queries were refused as retired, so that series is single-retrieval and unverified. Region 5 flu test positivity is rising. The 2026-27 Region 5 baseline was not found; 2025-26 was 2.3% and the national baseline fell 3.1->2.9, so it is likely ~2.1-2.3%. Projecting ~0.2pt/week growth (2023-24 analog: 1.90->2.14->2.43) puts the first crossing most likely in week 47 (Thanksgiving week), with week 46 possible if the baseline is near 2.1%. Past Region 5 seasons show smooth climbs with little post-Thanksgiving dip, so the 3-week persistence rule rarely delays onset. Tail risk: Region 5 has lagged (IL and MN low, hospital admissions stable), and slow growth like 2024-25 pushes onset to 48+. No market found on Polymarket, Manifold, or Kalshi.
calls.reference_class: Region 5 ILINet first-crossing week in past seasons, conditional on wILI ~1.8-1.9% at week 45 and rising ~0.15-0.25pt/week (2023-24, 2019-20, 2024-25 trajectories)

calls.reasoning: Region 5 wILI per the Delphi epidata API (inconsistent responses: the Region 5 query returned data twice, other queries said the API is retired; figures match CDC's narrative) was 1.46/1.64/1.83% for weeks 43-45, below the region's baseline (2.3% in 2025-26; the 2026-27 value was not found and is likely about 2.1-2.3% given the national baseline drop from 3.1 to 2.9). Week 45 is effectively excluded. Rising about 0.2/week with lab positivity increasing, projected week 46 about 2.0-2.1% and week 47 (Thanksgiving week, historically a 0.13-0.32 point bump in R5 with no dip after) about 2.3-2.5%, so week 47 is the modal onset. Week 46 needs a lowered baseline. Later onsets are possible because IL, WI and MN are still low (1.1-1.2% ILI) and the 2025-26 analog did not cross until week 50. No prediction market found.
calls.reference_class: HHS Region 5 ILINet seasons with similar week-45 wILI levels (2023-24: 1.90 at wk45 then crossed about wk46-47; 2024-25: 1.79 at wk45, crossed about wk49-50; 2025-26: 1.37 at wk45, crossed wk50), adjusted for current rising trend

calls.reasoning: Region 5 wILI (Delphi fluview mirror of CDC ILINet, issue 202645) rose 1.23->1.46->1.64->1.83% over weeks 42-45 (~+0.19/wk), still below baseline per CDC week 45 FluView. The 2026-27 Region 5 baseline isn't published; it was 2.3% in 2025-26, and dropping the 2022-23 season for the low-ILI 2025-26 season (national baseline fell 3.1->2.9) suggests about 2.0-2.2%. Week 47 includes Thanksgiving, which in 2023-25 gave an ILI bump with no dip the week after, so once crossed it should stay above. Upward revisions (wk44 revised ~+0.1 regionally) could pull onset to 46 or even 45. Illinois at minimal activity, with Region 5 ED flu share and hospital admissions flat, gives some weight to later weeks. No human prediction market found.
calls.reference_class: Region 5 ILINet trajectories in 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 (weeks 45-50, Thanksgiving effect) combined with current-season growth rate and plausible baseline range
